title: Dinu Lipatti's birth chart
metaDescription: Dinu Lipatti's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 28.3° Pisces. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the nine placements whose signs are settled stand in Pisces — the Sun, Mercury, Venus and Mars. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's position resolves to 28.3° Pisces — deep enough in the third decan (20°–30°) that Mars, its traditional sub-ruler, colours the reading.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 18.5° Pisces, Venus was at 18.5° Pisces, Mars was at 24.3° Pisces. Read together: thought steeped in tone and memory; attraction that works by atmosphere; effort that surges when it matters.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The day's firmest angle joins Mercury and Venus — a conjunction holding at 0.0°. A conjunction concentrates rather than balances — the pair burns one fuel line. Behind it, Mars trine Saturn at 0.6°, and the Sun conjunction Mars at 4.0° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: Uranus makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The dignity table, which predates the outer planets and only ever spoke for seven, marks three placements here. Mercury in Pisces at 18.5° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Venus in Pisces at 18.5° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Saturn in Cancer at 23.7° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain. The table describes circumstance rather than quality — a planet in detriment is inconvenienced, not diminished.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The certain ground: 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, dividing 6 water, 1 earth, 1 air, 1 fire by element and 4 mutable, 3 fixed, 2 cardinal by mode. Water weights a chart toward the felt and the remembered — information that arrives as atmosphere before it arrives as words. Saturn and Neptune were retrograde — the optical reversal the tradition reads as review — energy turned over before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Capricorn into Aquarius during that day at the birthplace, travelling 14.6° between one midnight and the next. A birth time would settle it in a second; there isn’t one. So the Moon stays unnamed here — the alternative is a guess wearing the clothes of a fact.
